items.headline: Boise State rallies past Texas State to remain Group of 6's CFP front-runner
items.description: Max Cutforth threw three touchdown passes in the final seven minutes in relief of injured starter Maddux Madsen as No. 20 Boise State rallied to beat Texas State 46-45 after blowing a 25-point halftime lead.

items.headline: No. 20 Boise State rallies to beat Texas State 46-45 after blowing a 25-point halftime lead
items.description: — Max Cutforth threw three touchdown passes in the final seven minutes in relief of injured starter Maddux Madsen, and No. 20 Boise State rallied to beat Texas State 46-45 on Saturday night after blowing a 25-point halftime lead.
